shared.tagline.text: Menya igihe cyo gutegereza mbere yo kwinjira.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Yigenga, kandi nta isano ifitanye na Uber Eats, Deliveroo cyangwa Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Nta raporo nshya? PickupRadar ishobora kwerekana {likelyFast} cyangwa {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): igihe cyo gutegereza gufata ku bashoferi mu Bwongereza

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Reba igihe abashoferi bategereza mu resitora no mu maduka mbere yo kwinjira. Ku bashoferi ba Uber Eats, Deliveroo na Just Eat mu Bwongereza. Nta kwiyandikisha.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Menya igihe cyo gutegereza mbere yo kwinjira.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Utwara ibintu kuri Uber Eats, Deliveroo cyangwa Just Eat? Reba igihe gishya cyo gutegereza ahafatirwa ibicuruzwa mu resitora no mu maduka. Irinde gutegereza kirekire. Kanda {reportWait} ubone {radarPoints}. Nta kwiyandikisha.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Ubu i Milton Keynes. Hakurikira London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Porogaramu za iPhone na Android zizaza vuba.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Urugero rw'ikidirishya ry'ahabanza rya PickupRadar, tabu {nearby} ifunguye. Ahafatirwa hafite ibara hashingiwe ku gihe cyo gutegereza

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Ikidirishya cy'urugero: igihe cyo gutegereza cy'urugero, si raporo y'ako kanya y'abashoferi

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Ikidirishya cy'urugero. Iki ni igihe cyo gutegereza cy'urugero, si raporo y'ako kanya. {live} amakuru y'ukuri.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Koresha {nearby} kugira ngo ubone ahafatirwa hafi yawe iyo aho uri hafunguwe. Koresha {fast} na {slow} kugira ngo urebe ibihe byo gutegereza n'ibyegeranyo.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Gerageza izina, akarere cyangwa kode y'iposita, nk'urugero KFC cyangwa Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Ikidirishya {reportWait} gifunguka. Hitamo igihe cyo gutegereza. Nta kintu cyoherezwa.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Ubona ibimenyetso bimwe muri porogaramu. Abashoferi ni bo babitanga, si porogaramu yo gutanga.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Abashoferi bahitamo igihe cyo gutegereza. Ubona igihe cyo gutegereza kiriho n'umubare w'abashoferi babitangye mu masaha 2 ashize.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Bigaragara gusa iyo nta raporo nshya. Ibi ni ibyegeranyo, si raporo y'ako kanya.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Abashoferi bakanda {reportProblem} kugira ngo babitange. Ubona raporo mbere yo kujya hariya.

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Intambwe eshatu zoroshye. Gutanga raporo bifata amasegonda make.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Nta ijambo ry'ibanga. Porogaramu iguha umwirondoro wa Radar ubwayo. Ntugomba kwiyandikisha.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Shakisha ahafatirwa. Reba igihe cyo gutegereza kiriho, cyangwa {likelyFast} cyangwa {likelySlow} niba nta raporo nshya.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Nyuma yo gufata iteka, kanda {reportWait}. Bifata amasegonda make. Raporo yawe ifasha abandi bashoferi, kandi ubona {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Ahafatirwa hujuje ibisabwa hafi yawe, nta gihe gishya cyo gutegereza, kandi nta {likelyFast} cyangwa {likelySlow}. Ubona 15 RP kuri iyo raporo, si 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Ibi ni imijyi y'Ubwongereza iri muri porogaramu. Ntubona umujyi wawe? Usabe muri porogaramu. Cyangwa ukande {notify} ku mujyi uri {comingSoon}. Tuzakwandikira imeri iyo ubayeho.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Si igice cya porogaramu iyo ari yo yo yo gutanga

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar yigenga. Si igice cya Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat cyangwa indi porogaramu yo gutanga. Ntigikoresha konti yawe hano.

home.trust.loginLead.text: Nta kwinjira muri porogaramu yo gutanga.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Ntidusaba izina cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga rya Uber Eats, Deliveroo cyangwa Just Eat.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Nta zina, aderesi cyangwa nimero y'iteka.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Oya. Porogaramu iguha umwirondoro wa Radar ubwayo. Ushobora gutanga igihe cyo gutegereza ako kanya. Kugira ngo urinze {radarPoints}, ongeraho imeri nyuma. Nta ijambo ry'ibanga. Porogaramu yohereza kode y'imibare 6 kuri imeri.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Porogaramu za iPhone na Android zizaza vuba. Ubu, {preview} yerekana ahafatirwa nyakuri n'igihe cyo gutegereza i Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Nta gukurikirana inyuma. Porogaramu ikoresha aho uri mugihe uyikoresha, kugira ngo yerekane ahafatirwa hafi kandi igenzure ko uri ahafatirwa mugihe utanga raporo. Urubuga rubaza aho uri gusa iyo uhisemo kubukoresha. Soma {privacy} kugira ngo umenye byinshi.

app.meta.title.text: Igaragaza ry'ako kanya rya porogaramu — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Gerageza porogaramu PickupRadar n'amakuru y'ukuri ya Milton Keynes. Reba hafi, shakisha ahafatirwa urebe ikidirishya cya raporo.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Iyi ni PickupRadar n'amakuru y'ukuri ya Milton Keynes. Reba hafi. Shakisha ahafatirwa ukahafungura. Icyo ukanda hano nticyoherezwa. Ushobora gutanga raporo muri porogaramu ya telefoni gusa.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Igaragaza ryuzuye rya porogaramu PickupRadar n'amakuru y'ukuri ya Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Ubufasha bwa PickupRadar: vugana n'ubufasha, tanga ikibazo cy'ahafatirwa, kandi ushake ibisubizo ku mwirondoro wa Radar, {radarPoints} no gusiba konti.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Ukeneye ubufasha? Andikira imeri ku bijyanye na porogaramu, ahafatirwa, {radarPoints} cyangwa ibanga ryawe.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Andikira imeri ku bufasha, igitekerezo, ikibazo cy'ahafatirwa cyangwa ikibazo cy'ibanga:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Ku mabaruwa gusa. Imeri ni yo nzira yihuse yo kutwandikira.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Akarere cyangwa kode y'iposita, niba ubizi

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Ubwoko bwa telefoni yawe, niba ikibazo kiri muri porogaramu

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Porogaramu iguha umwirondoro wa Radar ubwayo. Ntugomba kwinjira kugira ngo ukoreshe PickupRadar cyangwa ubone {radarPoints}. Kongeraho imeri ni ubushake. Birinda {radarPoints} niba uhinduye cyangwa usubiza telefoni. Nta ijambo ry'ibanga. Porogaramu yohereza kode y'imibare 6 kuri imeri.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Ubona {radarPoints} kuri raporo yemewe y'igihe cyo gutegereza ({waitRp}, cyangwa {neededRp} iyo {reportNeeded} yanditswe), agahimbazamusyi ka raporo ya mbere ({firstRp}) n'ahafatirwa twemeje ({approvedRp}). Ushobora gutumira umushoferi uhereye kuri {profile}. Mwembi mukeneye konti ya Radar irinzwe (ongeraho imeri). Inshuti yawe yandika kode yawe mbere ya raporo ya mbere yemewe y'igihe cyo gutegereza. Inshuti yawe ikora raporo 3 zemewe z'igihe cyo gutegereza, byibuze ku minsi 2 itandukanye (igihe cya UTC), ahantu 2 hatandukanye hafatirwa, buri wese abona {referralRp}. {rewards} Ntushobora gukoresha {radarPoints} ubu.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} ifite {messages}: itangazo, impuruza n'ubutumwa bwite ku mujyi wawe cyangwa umwirondoro wa Radar. Ubutumwa bwa kera cyangwa bwakuwe bushobora kutongera kugaragara.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Siba konti muri porogaramu: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Cyangwa wandikire {email}. Niba utongeyeho imeri, porogaramu yerekana {deleteProfile}. Reba paji {page} kugira ngo umenye intambwe.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Ahafatirwa ntihariho? Kanda {suggest} muri porogaramu. Hari ikitagenze neza? Kanda {reportProblem}. Cyangwa utwandikire, tuzabireba.

support.topics.delivery.title.text: Konti yawe ya porogaramu yo gutanga

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar ntiyifatanya na konti yawe ya Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat cyangwa indi porogaramu yo gutanga. Ntidusaba kwinjira, ijambo ry'ibanga, ibisobanuro bya konti, ibisobanuro by'umukiriya cyangwa ibisobanuro by'iteka. Abashoferi basangira raporo zo gufata gusa, nk'igihe cyo gutegereza n'ikibazo cy'ahafatirwa.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Gerageza PickupRadar mbere y'uko porogaramu isohoka.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Igaragaza ry'ako kanya ryerekana ahafatirwa nyakuri n'igihe cyo gutegereza i Milton Keynes. Gutanga raporo na {radarPoints} biri muri porogaramu ya telefoni gusa.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Iyo paji ntiba ku rubuga rwa PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Iyi paji iri hanze ya radar.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Iyo aderesi ntiba ku rubuga rwa PickupRadar. Izi paji zirahari:

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Incamake n'imitwe y'ibice byahinduwe. Politiki y'ibanga yuzuye iri mu Cyongereza, kandi verisiyo y'Icyongereza ni yo yemewe.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar ifasha abashoferi batwara ibyatumijwe kubona no gutanga raporo ku gihe cyo gutegereza mu gufata ibyatumijwe n'ibibazo by'ahantu.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Ushobora kureba nta konti. Porogaramu ikora umwirondoro wa Radar utazwi kuri telefoni yawe, kandi konti ya imeli ni ubushake.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Niwemera aho uri, porogaramu iharukoresha gusa igihe uyikoresha: gutondeka ahantu ho gufatira hafi, kumenya umujyi wawe, no kugenzura ko uri aho hantu igihe wohereza raporo y'ako kanya. Ntitubika aho uri hamwe na raporo zawe.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Ahantu ho gufatira wabitse hasigara kuri telefoni yawe.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Ntitugurisha amakuru yawe bwite, kandi porogaramu nta bikurikirana by'amatangazo cyangwa isesengura ifite.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Ushobora gusiba umwirondoro wawe wa Radar cyangwa konti muri porogaramu, cyangwa ukatwandikira kuri imeli ubidusaba. Reba {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Siba konti yawe cyangwa amakuru yawe — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Uko wasiba konti ya PickupRadar, umwirondoro wa Radar n'amakuru abifitanye isano, ndetse nta porogaramu.

delete.h1.text: Siba konti yawe cyangwa amakuru yawe

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Uru rupapuro rusobanura uko wasiba konti yawe ya PickupRadar, umwirondoro wawe wa Radar n'amakuru abifitanyeho isano, ndetse niba utagifite porogaramu. PickupRadar yakozwe na Hamza Khan.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Manuka maze ukande {deleteAccount} niba warinze RadarPoints zawe ukoresheje imeli, cyangwa {deleteProfile} niba utarabikoze.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Gusiba bitangira ako kanya. Nyuma yaho porogaramu itangiza umwirondoro mushya wa Radar utazwi kuri telefoni yawe.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Dusabe gusiba konti yawe ya imeli

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Niba warinze RadarPoints zawe ukoresheje aderesi ya imeli kandi ukaba udashobora gukoresha porogaramu:

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: uvuye kuri aderesi ya imeli ya konti yawe ya PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Tuzasubiza kuri iyo aderesi kugira ngo twemeze icyifuzo mbere yo gusiba ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Niwandika uvuye kuri indi aderesi, tuzakenera kwemeza ko ari wowe ugenzura aderesi ya imeli ya konti. Ntituzigera tugusaba ijambo ry'ibanga cyangwa kode yo kwinjira. Ntutwoherereze kode yawe.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Niba utarigeze wongeraho aderesi ya imeli, umwirondoro wawe wa Radar uhujwe gusa n'indangamuntu itunguranye ibitswe muri porogaramu kuri telefoni yawe. Inzira yoroshye yo kuwusiba ni muri porogaramu, ukurikije intambwe ziri hejuru.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Gusiba porogaramu bikura iyo ndangamuntu kuri telefoni yawe, ariko {not} inyandiko ziri kuri seriveri zacu.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Kuba nyir'umwirondoro utazwi bishobora kwemezwa gusa uhereye kuri telefoni wakorewemo, ukoresheje indangamuntu itunguranye na kode y'ibanga bibitswe muri porogaramu. Ibisobanuro nk'izina rya Radar, umujyi cyangwa amatariki wakoresheje porogaramu ntibyemeza ko umwirondoro ari uwawe, kuko n'abandi bashobora kubimenya. Ni yo mpamvu niba utagifite porogaramu, bishoboka ko tutabasha gusiba umwirondoro utazwi. Ariko ushobora kohereza imeli kuri {email} tukagusobanurira icyo dushobora gukora.

delete.alerts.title.text: Imeli z'imenyesha ryo gutangiza mu mijyi

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Ushobora gukuraho imenyesha ryo gutangiza muri porogaramu, cyangwa ukatwandikira uvuye kuri aderesi wiyandikishijeho tugasiba iyandikwa ry'iyo aderesi. Imeli z'imenyesha ryo gutangiza nazo zisibwa mu buryo bwikora, nk'uko {privacy} yacu ibisobanura.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Umwirondoro wawe wa Radar, izina rya Radar, RadarPoints n'amateka y'uruhare rwawe

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Kwinjira kwawe ukoresheje imeli, niba wari ufite konti ya imeli

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Isano hagati y'indangamuntu y'igikoresho cya telefoni yawe n'umwirondoro wawe

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Kode zawe zo gutumira, n'uko ubutumwa bwo muri porogaramu bwasomwe cyangwa bwafunzwe

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Kwiyandikisha ku imenyesha ryo gutangiza bifitanye isano n'umwirondoro wawe cyangwa telefoni yawe

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Inyandiko ziri kuri raporo z'ibibazo, raporo z'imimerere n'ibyifuzo by'ahantu bifitanye isano n'umwirondoro wawe

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, nk'igihe cyo gutegereza, raporo z'imimerere n'ibirango by'ahantu, n'ibyifuzo by'ahantu: indangamuntu y'igikoresho mu nyandiko zifitanye isano n'umwirondoro wawe isimbuzwa agaciro gatunguranye, bityo mu bubiko bwacu bw'amakuru ntizikiri zifitanye isano n'umwirondoro wawe. Zigifite ibisobanuro nk'ahantu n'igihe, bityo zakuweho ibiranga umuntu, ariko ntizitazwi burundu. Zishobora kubikwa kugira ngo zikomeze gufasha abandi bashoferi.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} kuri konti za imeli (indango y'imbere ya konti, indangamuntu y'igikoresho, kopi ya kode y'ibanga ya telefoni yahishwe mu buryo bumwe, n'amatariki), kugira ngo gusiba birangire mu mutekano kandi bigaragazwe ko byabaye.

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: utanga ububiko bwacu bw'amakuru abika kopi z'ubwizigame za buri munsi mu minsi 7, bityo amakuru yasibwe ashobora kuguma muri kopi y'ubwizigame kugeza ku minsi 7.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} zerekeye icyifuzo cyawe, igihe cyose bikenewe kugira ngo gikemurwe.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Ku bisobanuro byuzuye ku gihe tumara tubika amakuru n'ubundi burenganzira bwawe, reba {privacy} yacu.
